entities.name: Bergamo Botanical Garden "Lorenzo Rota"
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Orto Botanico di Bergamo "Lorenzo Rota" is a botanical garden located at the top of a long stairway from Scaletta di Colle Aperto, Bergamo, Lombardy, Italy. It is open daily during the warmer months.
